name: glasspad-base
description: Pinned base libraries served inside the null-origin artifact sandbox. Link base.css for the --gp-* design system (Glass Light / Glass Dark) and load charts.js for gp.chart() over Vega-Lite.

base.css.description: The --gp-* design-system tokens (light/dark/auto) plus base element styles for fragment artifacts.

charts.js.description: Defines window.gp; lazily loads the Vega stack from this host and exposes gp.chart().

bridge.js.description: Auto-injected into fragment-wrapped artifacts. Intercepts same-space relative-link clicks and asks the trusted parent to swap the iframe (validated postMessage bridge), and applies the theme the parent hands down on a toggle. Not needed by full-document artifacts, which opt in themselves and fall back to target=_top.

gp.chart.description: Render a Vega-Lite specification into a container, themed from the current --gp-* tokens. Re-renders automatically when the surrounding data-theme changes.

params.elOrSelector: Element | string — the container element, or a CSS selector for it.

opts.actions: boolean (default false) — show the Vega-Embed actions menu.
opts.theme: boolean (default true) — apply the Glasspad --gp-* theme config.
opts.reactiveTheme: boolean (default true) — re-render on data-theme change.

gp.chart.returns: Promise resolving to the vega-embed result ({ view, spec, ... }). The chart's Vega view is also stashed on the container as el.__gpView.
gp.chart.constraints: Specs must be self-contained: the sandbox sets connect-src 'none', so data.url / external images / remote fonts cannot load — use inline data.values.
gp.chart.example: gp.chart('#chart', { mark: 'bar', data: { values: [{a:'A',b:4},{a:'B',b:7}] }, encoding: { x: {field:'a',type:'nominal'}, y: {field:'b',type:'quantitative'} } });

gp.themeConfig.description: Build a Vega config object from the current --gp-* tokens (axis, legend, title colors and the categorical palette).
